title: festuca cinerea var. trachyphylla
intro: Festuca cinerea var. trachyphylla, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a type of grass species that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a bronchodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which can help to alleviate respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Festuca cinerea var. trachyphylla include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Additionally, this plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, cardiovascular problems, and gastrointestinal disorders.
